declarations.description:
A month (or quarter, half-year or year) picker, like the billing-period and card-expiry pickers of Stripe, the
period selector of an accounting report and the month view of every calendar: a year with its twelve months (four
quarters, two halves), and the title button opens a grid of years to jump between them. The value is a `YYYY-MM`
string, as an `<input type="month">` gives, `YYYY-Qn` with `granularity="quarter"`, `YYYY-Hn` with
`granularity="half-year"`, or `YYYY` with `granularity="year"`.

`fiscal-start` moves the start of the year for quarters, half-years and years: with `fiscal-start="7"` the year
`2027` runs from July 2026 to June 2027 (a fiscal year is named after the calendar year it ends in) and `2027-Q1` is
July to September 2026. `from` and `to` resolve the value to its first and last day. `stepper` adds a bar with the
period picked and arrows that step it through whole periods.

`min` and `max` disable the periods outside them and stop the paging there. Month names come from the page's language
(`Intl.DateTimeFormat`). The cells are a grid with one tab stop: the arrow keys move by cell and by row, Home and End
go to the start and end of a row, Page Up and Page Down change the year (or the page of years), and Enter or Space
picks.

It is a form control: under a `name` the form receives the value, `required` asks for one, and inside a
`c2-form-field` the field's label names it and its hint and error describe it.

members.name: value
members.description:
The period picked: `YYYY-MM` for a month, `YYYY-Qn` for a quarter, `YYYY-Hn` for a half-year, `YYYY` for a year,
following `granularity`. A value in another format is ignored.

members.name: granularity
members.description: Pick a month, a quarter, a half-year or a year.

members.name: fiscalStart
members.description:
The month (1 to 12) the fiscal year starts in, for quarters, half-years and years. A fiscal year is named after the
calendar year it ends in, so with `7` the year `2027` runs from July 2026 to June 2027. Months are always calendar
months.

members.name: stepper
members.description: Shows the period picked between two arrows that step it to the previous or next whole period.

members.name: min
members.description: The earliest period that can be picked, in any of the value's formats (a year with `fiscal-start` is a fiscal year).

members.name: max
members.description: The latest period that can be picked, in any of the value's formats.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the form receives the value under it.

members.name: required
members.description: Asks for a value before the form submits.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns the picker off; the value is kept and, as for a disabled form control, not submitted.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the picker. Inside a `c2-form-field`, the field's label names it.

members.name: viewYear
members.description: The year whose periods are shown.

members.name: view
members.description: The periods of a year, or a page of years.

members.name: focusKey
members.description: The cell that holds the grid's tab stop: a period or a `YYYY` year.

members.name: from
members.description: The first day of the period picked, as `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `''` without a value.

members.name: to
members.description: The last day of the period picked, as `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `''` without a value.

members.name: stepUp
members.description:
Moves the value `count` whole periods later, as an input's `stepUp()` does, and fires no event. With no value it
becomes the current period. A period outside `min`/`max` is not taken.

members.name: stepDown
members.description: Moves the value `count` whole periods earlier; see `stepUp()`.

members.name: valueYear
members.description: The year of the value, as `YYYY`.

members.name: offset
members.description: The months from January to the fiscal year's first month: 0 for calendar years, and always for months.

members.name: range
members.description: The first and last month of a period in any format, or `null` when it is none.

members.name: periodAt
members.description: The period of `unit` that holds a month.

members.name: stepped
members.description: The period `count` periods after the value (before it when negative); with no value, the current period.

members.name: showValue
members.description: Brings the picked value (or today) into view.

members.name: keys
members.description: The keys of the cells shown for a year (or the page of years holding it), in reading order.

members.name: columns
members.description: Cells per row: three months or years, two quarters or halves.

members.name: tabStop
members.description: The cell holding the tab stop: the one last focused, else the value, else the current period, else the first enabled.

members.name: yearName
members.description: A year's name: `2026`, or `FY2026` with `fiscal-start`.

members.name: months
members.description: The months a period covers, as `Jul – Sep` (with the year, `Jul – Sep 2026`).

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when the user picks a period, before `change`. Read `value`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after the user picks a period, in the grid or with the stepper. Not fired for programmatic changes.
